concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-adyen-pricing-fees]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree-hosted Adyen-processor pricing snapshot covering fee categories, qualified IC++ and Amex account paths, payout deduction, refund and dispute-fee treatment, and reporting boundaries; not independent or current universal Adyen rates
warnings: Preserve the page's merchant, card, processing-technology, region, currency, and account-path qualifications; do not present it as a universal Adyen fee schedule.
The snapshot provides no numeric merchant-specific rates and is Braintree-hosted rather than independent current Adyen authority.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-adyen-pricing-fees]] - Adyen-processor fee-reporting route to the payout-generated Settlement Details Report, with monthly-invoice coverage mismatch and an explicit warning that the invoice is only a high-level snapshot and should not be used for reconciliation
warnings: Do not treat the monthly Adyen invoice as reconciliation evidence or infer that report generation proves an individual payout or deposit arrived.
